category_fits.label: Consumer Behavior & Insights
category_fits.why_fit: The report centers on how U.S. consumers’ technology and media use, shopping behavior, expectations, and preferences changed during shelter in place and what may persist afterward.
category_fits.why_not_fit: The report also gives companies an action agenda, but that agenda is grounded in the consumer behavior findings rather than replacing them as the main subject.

category_fits.label: Omnichannel Commerce
category_fits.why_fit: The report measures online shopping participation and consumers’ intent to continue buying from new online retailers.
category_fits.why_not_fit: It does not center on an integrated shopper journey spanning ecommerce, stores, and service layers; ecommerce is one topic among technology and media behaviors.
supported_topic_rules: Evidence repeatedly links online and offline shopping, store and ecommerce integration, or end-to-end shopper journey design.

category_fits.label: Technology & Innovation
category_fits.why_fit: The report covers technology use and recommends accelerating digital experiences, including telemedicine and social viewing.
category_fits.why_not_fit: Technology is mainly the setting for observed consumer behavior and a supporting company capability; the report does not focus on infrastructure, architecture, or technology innovation as its main lens.
supported_topic_rules: Evidence repeatedly discusses infrastructure, enterprise technology, robotics, cybersecurity, hardware, or major technology shifts.
rule_evidence_sections: The Actionable Rewire to Restart Agenda

category_fits.label: Business Performance & Growth
category_fits.why_fit: A substantial part of the report translates consumer shifts into company growth actions: sustaining demand, reactivating and acquiring customers, redefining value propositions and pricing, and pursuing growth investments.
category_fits.why_not_fit: The report is not primarily a performance benchmark: its central evidence describes consumer behavior and stated expectations rather than company revenue, profitability, or measured commercial outcomes.
evidence_sections: The Actionable Rewire to Restart Agenda

category_fits.label: Advertising Strategy & Media
category_fits.why_fit: The report discusses technology and media use and recommends aligning advertisers and categories with changed consumer expectations.
category_fits.why_not_fit: It does not center on advertising strategy, media planning, buying, effectiveness, or investment; media consumption is studied as part of broader consumer behavior.
evidence_sections: The Actionable Rewire to Restart Agenda
supported_topic_rules: Evidence repeatedly covers media channels, ad receptivity, media planning, brand lift, investment priorities, or advertising strategy.
rule_evidence_sections: The Actionable Rewire to Restart Agenda

category_fits.label: Streaming & Connected TV
category_fits.why_fit: The report covers streaming and video time-spend behavior, among several forms of technology and media use.
category_fits.why_not_fit: Streaming is only one part of a broad report that also covers gaming, audio, online shopping, sports, and digital activities; CTV or streaming economics are not dominant.
supported_topic_rules: Evidence repeatedly covers streaming platforms, CTV inventory, OTT audiences, FAST, or television-like video ad strategy.
